web_report_filter.customer_facing_explanation: The available IndexerLabs file is a reconstructed representation of the Oxford index and contains character-transcription defects not visible in the authoritative OUP preview. The original evaluation scores the file exactly as delivered. The adjusted views remove confirmed or reasonably attributable reconstruction penalties so that the published index is not disadvantaged by defects that may not have appeared in the book. The publisher-favorable estimate deliberately resolves remaining representation uncertainty in Oxford’s favor.

views.methodology_note: Observed evaluation of the reconstructed IndexerLabs file exactly as delivered; no representation correction is applied.
views.uncertainty_status: Observed reconstruction; authoritative-copy fidelity is conflicting and the OUP preview is partial.

views.label: Adjusted for confirmed reconstruction defects
views.methodology_note: Removes only confirmed or conclusive representation-only penalties and re-resolves the levée cross-reference; all source-grounded judgments remain frozen.
views.uncertainty_status: Residual unknown-origin differences remain charged or score-neutral; this is not an observed full-OUP evaluation.

views.label: Publisher-favorable estimate
views.methodology_note: Also applies strongly inferred display corrections and declines to charge two reasonable unknown-origin mechanical anomalies, while preserving every independent indexing defect.
views.uncertainty_status: Deliberately optimistic upper bound; reasonable remaining reconstruction uncertainty is resolved in Oxford’s favor.
